term: selected origin fork, shared essential production and realization
definition: OriginFork conditionally classifies the selected occurring accidental feature as essence-produced or having an externalFeatureCause witness. SharedProduction transfers essenceProduces(essenceOf x,f) to essenceProduces(essenceOf y,f) for THIS pair/kind. Realization converts the latter selected production into occurs(y,f). All three are supplied OPEN policies, not independently established causal laws.
note: Selected realization is only at y,f; no unnecessary universal realization is required. Agreement in necessity or common conceptual predication does not prove shared essential production. The fork is not a full essential/accidental coverage theorem; only an already classified accidental case is considered. Its interpretation and exhaustiveness require independent defense. Repeated natural-kind characteristics may orient the production-sharing question, but no shared numeric essence or adequate causal mechanism follows merely from a label. External cause of qualitative difference does not yield existential dependence without real individuation/constitution coverage. No God, necessary root, actual existence, c≠x, concrete carrier, modal-world relation or strictness/minimality claim is built in.
